**[P2] Prevent a reentrant change from being overwritten by an older snapshot**

`_emit` runs configurable content/result callbacks while holding the reentrant lock. A callback can synchronously invoke `on_operation_change`, adopt a newer operation map, and schedule its record; the outer frame then resumes here and schedules its older snapshot afterward, either coalescing away or exporting after the newer state. Track a monotonically increasing state revision and schedule only if it is unchanged, or build outside the lock and revalidate before handoff. Add a guarded reentrant-change test.
